purpose: finite transfer check of the input-validity guide wording on two fresh families (see PREREG.md); frozen before any agent ran
includes: coverage contract and optional feasibility adapter (batch 013 bytes), pinned-adapter enforcement, and the build/change guide wording that input-validity refusals are when-guards

targeted_regressions_on_packed_binary.rust_suite_on_source: run by the acceptance gate on the source revision; not re-run separately for this record

isolation: evaluators, reference toys, defect controls and attack harness are one encrypted archive; the key was moved out of the experiment tree to a private file in the lead's home configuration before dispatch, and all plaintext was deleted before dispatch (oracle authors' own sessions retain their transcripts). Same-account isolation limits from the custody check still apply: no general sandbox is claimed.
instrument_selftest: through the scorer path on these bytes, both families: reference passes build and change; host-only fails change (and build); missing-input-validity fails change with criterion 2 failing on exactly the input-validity rules (N18: abort_note, paper_grade; N19: abort_clear, lane_bound); stale, always-refuse and breaks-old fail. Output: SELFTEST OK.
what_this_supports: a finite check that input-validity rules named in a brief were or were not enforced by machine guards on two fresh families; not a rate, a comparison, DFYJourneyQualified or any claim about other families
limits: no Linux x64, no human participants, agent model identity not exposed, both families TypeScript, n=2 per family, feasibility adapter off
